name: fausth
description: Faust Harness — portable Counterbalance Contract runtime

scripts.fausth: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts
scripts.validate: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts validate
scripts.replay: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts replay
scripts.live: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts live --deployment ../../examples/greenhouse/deployment.openrouter-free.yml --scenarios ../../live/scenarios --report ../../live/reports/out.json --catch-rate-min 0.5
scripts.live:cb: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts live --deployment ../../examples/coding-counterbalance/deployment.openrouter-free.yml --scenarios ../../live/scenarios-coding-counterbalance --report ../../live/reports/coding-counterbalance-openrouter.json --catch-rate-min 0.5
scripts.live:support: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts live --deployment ../../examples/support-bot/deployment.openrouter-free.yml --scenarios ../../live/scenarios-support-bot --report ../../live/reports/support-bot-openrouter.json --catch-rate-min 0.5
scripts.provider:probe: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts provider probe
scripts.ci:conformance: pnpm -C engines/ts test && pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts replay && node scripts/parity.mjs
scripts.ci:packaging: pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts test ../../examples/coding-counterbalance && pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts test ../../examples/support-bot && pnpm -C engines/ts exec node --import tsx src/cli.ts pack ../../examples/coding-counterbalance --out ../../live/reports/coding-counterbalance.fausth.json && node scripts/bundle-roundtrip.mjs && node scripts/bundle-signature-roundtrip.mjs
scripts.ci:resolve: node scripts/resolve-roundtrip.mjs && node scripts/connector-execution.mjs && node scripts/mcp-execution.mjs
scripts.ci:swe-recorded: node scripts/case-study-coding.mjs --manifest case-studies/swe-bench/manifest.yml --mode recorded --skip-conformance --tasks pallets__flask-4045 --reps 1 --run-id swe-recorded-ci
scripts.ci:tau-recorded: node scripts/case-study-coding.mjs --manifest case-studies/tau-bench/manifest.yml --mode recorded --skip-conformance --tasks retail-000 --reps 1 --run-id tau-recorded-ci
